subject.title: fix: cron main-session wakes skipped as disabled without per-agent heartbeat config [AI-assisted]

question: Should cron-owned main-session systemEvent wakes bypass per-agent heartbeat scheduler omission when global heartbeats are enabled?
rationale: The reported bug is concrete, but accepting the fix direction changes explicit per-agent heartbeat configuration semantics and there are multiple overlapping candidate PRs for the same issue.

options.title: Accept Cron Override After Full Fix
options.body: Require the queued scheduler-path repair and real cron proof, then accept cron scheduling as authoritative for main-session systemEvent wakes while the global disable gate remains authoritative.

options.title: Keep Per-Agent Omission Authoritative
options.body: Reject this bypass direction and keep the canonical issue open for a different implementation that does not wake agents omitted from heartbeat config.

options.title: Pick One Canonical Branch
options.body: Pause overlapping branches until maintainers choose one PR or replacement branch for the linked issue.

recommendation.title: Accept Cron Override After Full Fix
recommendation.body: Require the queued scheduler-path repair and real cron proof, then accept cron scheduling as authoritative for main-session systemEvent wakes while the global disable gate remains authoritative.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest recent history signal on both the heartbeat scheduler state and cron timer decision surface.
